name: aegis
install: go mod download && GOTOOLCHAIN=$(go env GOVERSION) go install github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/v2/cmd/golangci-lint@v2.4.0 && make build

terminals.name: aegis-server
terminals.description: Runs the aegis badge service (app on :8080, admin on :9090). GitHub badge routes need a valid GITHUB_ACCESS_TOKEN secret; /static and the admin routes work with any non-empty token.
terminals.command: if [ -n "$GITHUB_ACCESS_TOKEN" ]; then exec ./bin/aegis -log-format text; else echo 'GITHUB_ACCESS_TOKEN is not set. Add it as a Cloud Agent secret, then restart this terminal to run the aegis server.'; fi
